owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Can do everything, including every permission added later. Cannot be removed from the last owner.

check.name: Smoke check (automatic)
check.description: Read-only account the server signs in with after every deploy and every night to check that each page opens (CN-016). It can see but never change anything. Its password and two-step code live only on the server and change on every run.

vault.read: See which keys are connected (never the key itself)
vault.write: Add, replace or switch off keys

roles.read: See the roles and what each may do

staff.manage: Add staff, give or take roles, pause an account

audit.read: See the change history (who, when, from where)

dashboard.read: Open the Dashboard and its waiting work

metrics.read: See the money tiles (Sales and Ordered value)

help.read: Open the admin guides and the manual

media.upload: Upload photos, describe them, place them on products
media.manage: Archive and restore files, clean up unused ones, remake every size

catalogue.read: See products, colours, sizes, categories, fabrics and brands
catalogue.write: Change products, colours, sizes, categories, fabrics, brands, names and links
catalogue.prices: Set sale and compare-at prices of variants
catalogue.publish: Put products on the shop and take them off (only when the publish checklist passes)
catalogue.import: Bring in products from a CSV file or a supplier's link (preview first; a link only makes a draft; nothing is removed)
catalogue.export: Download the catalogue as a CSV file (never cost prices)
catalogue.interest: See who asked to be told when a product is back in stock (their phone or e-mail), and mark them as told
catalogue.sizeAdvice: Train Find My Size and switch a trained version on or off (it never changes a size chart)

inventory.read: See stock per colour and size, warehouses, locations and the ERP connection
inventory.locations: Add, rename and archive warehouses and locations (incl. the damaged bin), link them to ERP warehouses
inventory.erp: Choose where a store's stock and orders come from (our ERP, another ERP, none) and its ERP company and warehouse
inventory.sync: Bring stock from the ERP again now (all or one product), resend waiting ERP documents, check stock against the ERP
inventory.audit: Count a location by barcode and give a reason for each difference (stock itself is corrected in the ERP)

rules.read: See the Smart Rules, their history, clashes and simulations, the notices and the coupons
rules.write: Write rules, notices and coupons and save them as drafts (nothing reaches customers yet)
rules.publish: Publish a rule, pause or end it, and switch a notice on or off
rules.approve: Give the owner's OK for a rule that changes money: delivery charges, set prices, discounts, coupons, COD

combos.read: See the combos, the auto colour-pair rules, their pages and the combo report
combos.write: Make and change combos and combo rules: pieces, pairing, colours, names, templates (prices need their own permission)
combos.publish: Switch a combo or a combo rule on or off, archive it or bring it back, make set photos
combos.prices: Set or change a set price or a pack price (the owner's decision)

delivery.read: See the delivery bands, their charges and hours, and the sub-area list
delivery.charges: Set each band's delivery charge, hours and COD limit, switch a band on or off, choose how the sub-area is charged
delivery.areas: Add places to the sub-area list or take them off (nothing is deleted)

system.read: See the Server page: is the background worker alive, and which jobs failed

orders.invoice: Open and print the invoice of any order (it shows the customer's name, phone and address)
orders.read: See orders, their lines, money, timeline and notes
orders.hold: Put an order on hold with a reason, and release it
orders.cancel: Cancel an order before a courier is booked, with a reason (a paid order only gets a refund request; no money moves)
orders.cancelAfterBooking: Cancel after booking: ask the courier to cancel and record the courier's answer
orders.cancelRequests: Approve or refuse a customer's request to cancel
orders.notes: Write notes and set internal flags on an order

risk.decide: Decide a duplicate-order review: not a duplicate, cancel, hold or ask the customer

orders.merge: Put two open orders of one customer in one parcel (prices and charges stay as they are)
orders.lines: Add a line to an order not yet with the courier, or take out a line added after placing (priced as its product page; nothing else is priced again)
orders.edit: Edit an order not yet with the courier: the customer's name, phone and address, a size at the same price, or take a piece out (with a reason; prices, discounts, the delivery charge and COD never change)
orders.export: Export orders as a CSV file (no personal details)
orders.exportPersonal: Include the customer's name, phone, e-mail and address in an order export

reviews.read: See every review with its state (waiting, published, hidden)
reviews.moderate: Publish, hide or refuse a review and mark a verified buyer (approving a photo review also pays the photo reward, only while the owner has switched it on with his own amount)
reviews.write: Add a review the shop collected itself, and bring in a file of reviews

journey.read: See the order messages (steps, channels, limits)

selfConfirm.reply: Record a customer's self-confirm reply (1, 2 or 3)

log.view: See the message log (who got which message, failures and tries)
